long_biography.plain_text:
Multi grew from Alexander Embiricos’s interest in software that lets people work together directly. He studied mechanical engineering and computer science at Stanford before joining Dropbox as a product manager, where he gained experience building collaboration tools. He later co-founded Remotion, a video workspace for distributed teams, and renamed it Multi as the product expanded into shared control, collaborative notes and multiplayer interaction across desktop applications.

When Multi joined OpenAI, Embiricos and colleagues shifted from remote teamwork toward human collaboration with artificial intelligence. At OpenAI he became lead product manager for Codex, applying the same emphasis on shared context and coordinated work to coding agents. His role centres on designing how users delegate tasks to coding agents, preserve working context and review the resulting changes.
